messages.author: 4d8d57f5cd1aac78
messages.subject: User-defined function with dependence on external R/C++ package
parts:
Dear nimble team:

  Is it possible to write a custom function, which depends on some external R or C++ packages  and 
can be called inside nimblecode? More specifically, I wish to do a 2D FFT convolution of an image
in my model, and want to know if I could save the effort to implement a FFT algorithm by my own.

Best regards
Yuping
